# third_party

`vibe-editor.js` – the VIBE FM SDK's Editor-page API (SDK 16), © 2026 Sven Trogus, **Apache-2.0** (SPDX header in the
file; see `../official/sdk/LICENSE` and `NOTICE`). The build inlines it into the Editor page as a fallback for hosts whose
sandbox refuses the host-served copy. Taken unchanged from the SDK; the emulator around it is not part of this project.
